{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''2002 Ohio State Treasurer election''' was held on November 5, 2002, to elect the [[Ohio State Treasurer]]. Republican incumbent Treasurer [[Joe Deters]] defeated his Democratic opponent, former [[Ohio House of Representatives|Ohio House Representative]] [[Mary O. Boyle]], with 53.32% of the vote.

Deters would not serve a full second term as Treasurer as he would go on to resign in 2005 after winning election to [[Hamilton County, Ohio|Hamilton County]] Prosecuting Attorney.

== Republican primary ==
=== Candidates ===
*[[Joe Deters]], incumbent [[Ohio State Treasurer]] (1999–2005)
=== Campaign ===
The Republican primary was held on May 7, 2002. Deters won renomination without opposition.

== Democratic primary ==
=== Candidates ===
*[[Mary O. Boyle]], former [[Ohio House of Representatives|Ohio House Representative]] (1979–1984)
*Willis Blackshear, [[Montgomery County, Ohio|Montgomery County]] Recorder
=== Campaign ===
The Democratic primary was held on May 7, 2002. Boyle easily defeated Blackshear, her only opponent, in a landslide, winning 81.45% of the vote.
